name: Ray of Sorrow
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, lathspell 1, mesmerist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You shoot a ray of dark energy causing the target to be filled with doubt and sadness. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack against the target to affect them. If you hit, the target takes a -3 penalty on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks and skill checks.
